source.anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Group weighted fine increments by coarse dyadic cells. Exact assumptions and formula below.
source.original_text:
Fix a positive horizon and nested regular dyadic grids at levels m and n with m≤n. Assign each coarse cell a real weight and each fine cell a real value. The fine sum weighted by the enclosing coarse cell equals the weighted sum of consecutive differences of the fine prefix sums at coarse grid points.

The grids are regular dyadic grids of the same positive horizon T. The fine grid refines the coarse grid.
Each wⱼ and zᵢ is an arbitrary real number. The prefix includes the cell ending exactly at its cutoff.

\sum_i w_{c(i)}z_i=\sum_jw_j\bigl(P(s_{j+1})-P(s_j)\bigr),\qquad P(a)=\sum_{i:\ t_{i+1}\le a}z_i.

lean.statement:
theorem anonymous_target
  {T : NNReal} (hT : 0 < T) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (w : Fin (2 ^ m) → ℝ) (z : Fin (2 ^ n) → ℝ) :
  have s :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
      (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T m) (2 ^ m);
  have t :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
      (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n);
  have P := fun k => ∑ i, if t i.succ ≤ s k then z i else 0;
  ∑ i, w (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicElementaryRefinement.coarseCell hmn i) * z i =
    ∑ j, w j * (P j.succ - P j.castSucc)

blind_reconstruction.text:
Positive horizon T; natural dyadic levels m≤n; scalar coarse weights w and fine increments z; coarse/fine grids s,t; prefix sums P; coarse-cell map c.

T∈[0,infinity), T>0; w:{0,...,2^m-1}→R; z:{0,...,2^n-1}→R; s_k=kT/2^m; t_i=iT/2^n.

Assumptions: Only T>0 and m≤n; weights and increments are unrestricted real arrays.

Conclusion: For k=0,...,2^m put P_k=∑_{i=0}^{2^n-1}1_{t_{i+1}≤s_k} z_i. With c(i) the supplied coarseCell(m≤n,i), ∑_{i=0}^{2^n-1}w_{c(i)} z_i = ∑_{j=0}^{2^m-1}w_j(P_{j+1}-P_j). The refinement factor is 2^(n-m), and c(i)=floor(i/2^(n-m)) using natural-number division.

Quantifier order: For every T>0, natural m≤n, arbitrary w and z, the finite-sum identity holds.

Scope: Exact deterministic finite-sum equality, with right-endpoint inclusion in the prefix sums.

Constant dependencies: No existential constants. The coarse-cell map depends on m,n and the ordering proof.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicElementaryRefinement

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicBlockWeights

open scoped BigOperators NNReal
open ElementaryItoIntegral SampledElementaryApproximation DyadicElementaryRefinement

private theorem fine_right_le_coarse_point_iff
    {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (k : Fin (2 ^ m + 1)) (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
    regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n) i.succ ≤
      regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T m) (2 ^ m) k ↔
    (coarseCell hmn i).val < k.val := by
  let j := coarseCell hmn i
  let s := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T m) (2 ^ m)
  let t := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
  have hs := regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT m) (2 ^ m)
  have ht := regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT n) (2 ^ n)
  change t i.succ ≤ s k ↔ j.val < k.val
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra! hkj
    have hkl : k ≤ j.castSucc := hkj
    have hleft := (hs.monotone hkl).trans (coarse_left_endpoint_le_fine_left (T := T) hmn i)
    exact (not_le.mpr (hleft.trans_lt (ht Fin.castSucc_lt_succ))) h
  · intro hjk
    have hkr : j.succ ≤ k := Nat.succ_le_iff.2 hjk
    exact (fine_right_endpoint_le_coarse_right (T := T) hmn i).trans (hs.monotone hkr)

/-- Group a weighted fine sum into coarse blocks by differencing inclusive prefix sums. -/
theorem dyadic_sum_coarse_weight_eq_prefix_differences
    {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (w : Fin (2 ^ m) → ℝ) (z : Fin (2 ^ n) → ℝ) :
    let s := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T m) (2 ^ m)
    let t := regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
    let P := fun k => ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), if t i.succ ≤ s k then z i else 0
    (∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), w (coarseCell hmn i) * z i) =
      ∑ j : Fin (2 ^ m), w j * (P j.succ - P j.castSucc) := by
  intro s t P
  have hcell (i : Fin (2 ^ n)) (j : Fin (2 ^ m)) :
      (if t i.succ ≤ s j.succ then z i else 0) -
        (if t i.succ ≤ s j.castSucc then z i else 0) =
      if coarseCell hmn i = j then z i else 0 := by
    change (if regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n) i.succ ≤
        regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T m) (2 ^ m) j.succ then z i else 0) -
      (if regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n) i.succ ≤
        regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T m) (2 ^ m) j.castSucc then z i else 0) = _
    simp only [fine_right_le_coarse_point_iff hT hmn, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (coarseCell hmn i).val j.val with h | h | h
    · have hne : coarseCell hmn i ≠ j := fun he => h.ne (congrArg Fin.val he)
      simp only [if_pos h, if_pos (h.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self _)), if_neg hne, sub_self]
    · have he : coarseCell hmn i = j := Fin.ext h
      simp [he]
    · have hne : coarseCell hmn i ≠ j := fun he => h.ne (congrArg Fin.val he).symm
      simp only [if_neg (not_lt.mpr (Nat.succ_le_iff.2 h)), if_neg (not_lt.mpr h.le),
        if_neg hne, sub_self]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ n), ∑ j : Fin (2 ^ m),
        w j * (if coarseCell hmn i = j then z i else 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (coarseCell hmn i)]
      · simp
      · intro j _ hj
        simp [Ne.symm hj]
      · simp
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      simp only [P, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, hcell]

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicBlockWeights

steps.text: The difference selects exactly the fine cells enclosed by the jth coarse cell. Interchanging the finite sums gives the displayed identity.
